items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Bobby was there with Sam Wooding in Europe.

ctx.x: Bobby was there with Sam Wooding in Europe.
Oh, he'd been to Europe with Sam.

Yeah. He came here for a while. So he came over to bring the musicians over to the World's Fair in Paris. So that was the thing. We were supposed to work in the Bronx(?), and... What the hell was the name of that place? Anyway, we played at the (?) Pavilion at the World's Fair. We also made a movie with Erich Von Stroheim.
